description: Source code for a SQLite wrapper class using 'better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers' and 'kysely' for database operations, including connection management, statement preparation, execution, extension loading, and error handling.

classes.name: SQLite
classes.description: A class providing an interface to manage SQLite database connections, prepare and execute statements, load extensions, and handle errors with retry logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new SQLite instance and logs creation.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a SQLite database file with 'better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers' in unsafe mode.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement with caching and retry logic on failure.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a prepared statement, returning query results or affected rows, and loads extensions if needed.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an SQL command, alias for 'exec'.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and clears prepared statements.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the database file after closing the connection.

methods.name: isDatabaseReady
methods.description: Checks if the database is ready by executing 'SELECT 1'.

methods.name: loadExtensions
methods.description: Loads specific SQLite extensions for trigram and FTS5 HTML support.
